alternatives_rejected.why: The diskio z of about 1e19 (E1, E4) is the size you get when the baseline had near-zero variance, so it is likely an artifact. A real disk fault would also slow the service's own work, but own self-time stayed flat at 0.14->0.13ms (E2).

Memory rose 485.8% (E4), but memory pressure would slow in-process handling, and own span self-time did not change (E2). Only the latency seen by callers grew 14x, which points to delay at the network boundary.
The frontend-external error spike in E1 follows from slow currencyservice responses (inbound p50 5.11->71.49ms in E2). No frontend-specific fault signal appears in the evidence.

proposed_fix.description: Check currencyservice's pod or network interface for an injected traffic-control delay rule (tc netem) and remove it. Then confirm that caller-observed p50 latency returns to about 5ms and that frontend-external errors clear. Keep investigating the memory growth separately if it persists.
